question: Which three distinct third-page visits are most frequently observed immediately after two consecutive visits to the '/detail' page, and how many times does each third-page visit occur?
sql:
-- Find the third-page visit after two consecutive /detail visits
-- Normalize paths: treat /detail and /detail/ as the same page
-- Deduplicate by (session, stamp, norm_path) to get unique visits per timestamp
-- Then find sessions where two consecutive unique visits are /detail
-- The "third-page visit" is the path after the pair
WITH normalized AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        stamp,
        session, 
        CASE WHEN path = '/detail/' THEN '/detail'
             WHEN path = '/search_list/' THEN '/search_list'
             WHEN path = '/search_input/' THEN '/search_input'
             ELSE path END as norm_path
    FROM activity_log
),
deduped AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT session, stamp, norm_path
    FROM normalized
),
ordered AS (
    SELECT 
        session,
        stamp,
        norm_path,
        LAG(norm_path) OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp, norm_path) as prev_path,
        LEAD(norm_path) OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp, norm_path) as next_path,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp, norm_path) as rn
    FROM deduped
),
-- Find the pair of consecutive /detail visits
detail_pairs AS (
    SELECT session, stamp, norm_path, prev_path, next_path, rn
    FROM ordered
    WHERE norm_path = '/detail' AND prev_path = '/detail'
)
-- Count occurrences of each third-page visit (next_path after the pair)
SELECT next_path as third_page_visit, COUNT(*) as occurrence_count
FROM detail_pairs
WHERE next_path IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY next_path
ORDER BY occurrence_count DESC, third_page_visit
LIMIT 3
